widgetTool.name: loan_preapproval
widgetTool.description: Emit a mortgage or loan pre-approval result with decision, rate, and monthly payment. Requires financial advice disclaimer. Before calling this tool, speak a brief conversational pacing phrase: 'Let me show you your pre-approval result.'

breakdown.description: Optional key/value rows shown below the fold: total repayable, first payment date, protection add-ons.

headline.description: One short line the customer reads first, e.g. 'You are pre-approved.'

interest_rate_pct.description: Rate used in the estimate. Rendered as a small footnote.

is_provisional.description: Required to be true when income was declared but not verified. UI shows a 'Provisional estimate' pill.

monthly_payment_cad.description: The single number the card leads with, in CAD.

name.description: Required. Always output the exact string: 'loan_preapproval'

primary_cta_label.description: Label for the primary action, e.g. 'Review in the app'.

primary_cta_value.description: Sent to the agent on tap, e.g. 'loan_confirm_review'.

product_image_url.description: For EPP: the gadget image. For mortgage: leave empty.

product_name.description: For EPP: the gadget name. For mortgage: property address or 'Home mortgage estimate'.

tenure_label.description: Human-readable tenure, e.g. '25 years' or '12 months'.

type.description: Required. Always output the exact string: 'custom_template'

verdict.description: pre_approved | needs_review | not_eligible. Never overridden by tone.
